hero.title: Scenic Greenland Cruises
hero.subtitle: Explore the Arctic in Six-Star Ultra-Luxury aboard Scenic Eclipse, where colossal ice, remote fjords, and Inuit culture meet unrivaled exploration.

intro.heading: Experience the Untouched Beauty of the Arctic
paragraphs: Greenland is one of the world's last true wilderness destinations, where towering icebergs, dramatic fjords, ancient glaciers, and vibrant Inuit communities create an unforgettable expedition experience.

Aboard Scenic Eclipse, Scenic's award-winning Discovery Yacht—purpose-built and Polar Class 6 certified with advanced stabilization systems and an ice-strengthened hull for confident navigation in polar waters—you'll experience Greenland in exceptional comfort while exploring some of the most remote and spectacular landscapes on Earth.

Guests can sail through breathtaking fjords, admire colossal ice formations, visit colorful coastal villages, and learn about Inuit culture with guidance from Scenic's expert Discovery Team. Many itineraries seamlessly combine Greenland with Iceland, allowing travelers to experience two extraordinary Arctic destinations on a single voyage.

destinations.title: Incredible Greenland Destinations
destinations.subtitle: Each destination reveals a different side of the world's largest island, from iceberg-choked bays to ancient Inuit settlements.

items.name: Ilulissat & Icefjord
items.desc: One of Greenland's most iconic destinations, famous for the UNESCO-listed Ilulissat Icefjord, where colossal icebergs calve from Jakobshavn Glacier into the sea.

items.name: Disko Bay
items.desc: Renowned for spectacular floating icebergs and abundant marine wildlife. Guests frequently encounter humpback whales, fin whales, seals, and diverse Arctic seabirds.

items.name: East Greenland & Scoresby Sound
items.desc: One of the most remote regions on Earth, featuring the world's largest fjord system, towering Arctic mountains, massive glaciers, and small Inuit settlements.

items.name: Narsaq & South Greenland
items.desc: Located in southern Greenland, Narsaq charms with brightly painted wooden homes, dramatic coastal peaks, and a rich blend of Norse and Inuit history.

items.name: Prince Christian Sound
items.desc: A breathtaking narrow waterway framed by towering granite cliffs, cascading waterfalls, hanging glaciers, and drifting icebergs.

items.name: Qaqortoq
items.desc: The largest town in southern Greenland, featuring lovely colonial architecture, stone sculptures, historic churches, and panoramic fjord views.

seasons.title: Best Time for Scenic Greenland Cruises
seasons.subtitle: Greenland expedition sailings operate during the Arctic summer when ice conditions allow spectacular access.

items.title: June (Early Season)
items.desc: Longer daylight hours with the Midnight Sun, fresh pristine snow on coastal peaks, breaking pack ice, and active marine life.

items.title: July & August (Peak Summer)
items.desc: Peak expedition season with milder temperatures, optimal iceberg viewing in Disko Bay, thriving whale populations, and accessible hiking routes.

items.title: September (Early Autumn)
items.desc: Dramatic golden lighting, vibrant autumn tundra colors, crisp clear skies, fewer expedition vessels, and opportunities to view the Northern Lights.

faqs.question: Where do Scenic Greenland Cruises sail?
faqs.answer: Scenic itineraries visit destinations across Greenland, including Ilulissat, Disko Bay, East Greenland, Narsaq, and Prince Christian Sound. Many voyages also include Iceland.

faqs.question: Which ship sails to Greenland?
faqs.answer: Scenic Greenland expeditions are operated aboard Scenic Eclipse, Scenic's ultra-luxury Discovery Yacht.

faqs.question: Are Scenic Greenland Cruises all-inclusive?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most voyages include luxury accommodations, butler service, gourmet dining, premium beverages, Wi-Fi, gratuities, and expedition experiences.

faqs.question: What wildlife can I see in Greenland?
faqs.answer: Depending on the season, guests may see whales, seals, Arctic birds, musk oxen, and other wildlife.

faqs.question: Does Scenic include Zodiac excursions?
faqs.answer: Yes. Zodiac cruises and guided landings are key components of Scenic's Greenland expedition experience.

faqs.question: When is the best time to cruise Greenland?
faqs.answer: Most Greenland cruises operate between June and September, offering ideal weather and wildlife viewing opportunities.

faqs.question: Does Scenic visit Ilulissat?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many Greenland itineraries include Ilulissat and the spectacular UNESCO-listed Icefjord.

faqs.question: Are helicopter excursions available in Greenland?
faqs.answer: Helicopter operations are subject to itinerary, regulations, weather, and operational conditions. Scenic notes that helicopter experiences may be available on select voyages where permitted.

faqs.question: Is butler service included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every Scenic suite includes personalized butler service.

faqs.question: What should I pack?
faqs.answer: Warm layered clothing, waterproof outerwear, gloves, a hat, binoculars, sturdy walking shoes, and a camera are recommended.

faqs.question: Are Greenland cruises suitable for first-time expedition travelers?
faqs.answer: Yes. Scenic combines expert guidance with luxury amenities, making Greenland an excellent introduction to expedition cruising.

faqs.question: Is Wi-Fi included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Complimentary Wi-Fi is included on board.

faqs.question: How long are Scenic Greenland Cruises?
faqs.answer: Itineraries typically range from about 8 to 16 days depending on the route and destinations.

faqs.question: Can I combine Greenland with Iceland?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many Scenic itineraries include both Iceland and Greenland during the same voyage.

faqs.question: Why choose Scenic for Greenland?
faqs.answer: Scenic combines six-star luxury, all-inclusive amenities, expert expedition leadership, and immersive Arctic exploration, creating one of the most comprehensive luxury Greenland cruise experiences available.
